question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**enhance**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage discusses how farmers are adapting to the challenges caused by climate change.
 
• The correct verb must convey improvement or strengthening of farmers' ability to cope with these challenges.
 
• "**Enhance**" means to improve or increase the quality or strength of something, which fits the context perfectly.
 
• Other options like "**accept**", "**compromise**", and "**reduce**" do not fit the intended positive action of building resilience.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Accept** (स्वीकार करना): means to agree to or receive something, not suitable for building resilience.
 
• **Compromise **(समझौता करना): means to settle by reducing quality or standards, which conveys a negative sense here.
 
• **Reduce **(घटाना): means to make something smaller or less, which is opposite to the idea of strengthening resilience.
